name: servicediscovery
description: Cloud Map With Cloud Map, you can configure public DNS, private DNS, or HTTP namespaces that your microservice applications run in.

subcommands.name: create-http-namespace
subcommands.description: Creates an HTTP namespace.

subcommands.name: create-private-dns-namespace
subcommands.description: Creates a private namespace based on DNS, which is visible only inside a specified Amazon VPC.

subcommands.name: create-public-dns-namespace
subcommands.description: Creates a public namespace based on DNS, which is visible on the internet.

subcommands.name: create-service
subcommands.description: Creates a service.

subcommands.name: delete-namespace
subcommands.description: Deletes a namespace from the current account.

subcommands.name: delete-service
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified service and all associated service attributes.

subcommands.name: delete-service-attributes
subcommands.description: Deletes specific attributes associated with a service.

subcommands.name: deregister-instance
subcommands.description: Deletes the Amazon Route 53 DNS records and health check, if any, that Cloud Map created for the specified instance.

subcommands.name: discover-instances
subcommands.description: Discovers registered instances for a specified namespace and service.

subcommands.name: discover-instances-revision
subcommands.description: Discovers the increasing revision associated with an instance.

subcommands.name: get-instance
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified instance.

subcommands.name: get-instances-health-status
subcommands.description: Gets the current health status (Healthy, Unhealthy, or Unknown) of one or more instances that are associated with a specified service.

subcommands.name: get-namespace
subcommands.description: Gets information about a namespace.

subcommands.name: get-operation
subcommands.description: Gets information about any operation that returns an operation ID in the response, such as a CreateHttpNamespace request.

subcommands.name: get-service
subcommands.description: Gets the settings for a specified service.

subcommands.name: get-service-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns the attributes associated with a specified service.

subcommands.name: list-instances
subcommands.description: Lists summary information about the instances that you registered by using a specified service.

subcommands.name: list-namespaces
subcommands.description: Lists summary information about the namespaces that were created by the current Amazon Web Services account and shared with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-operations
subcommands.description: Lists operations that match the criteria that you specify.

subcommands.name: list-services
subcommands.description: Lists summary information for all the services that are associated with one or more namespaces.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: register-instance
subcommands.description: Creates or updates one or more records and, optionally, creates a health check based on the settings in a specified service.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-http-namespace
subcommands.description: Updates an HTTP namespace.

subcommands.name: update-instance-custom-health-status
subcommands.description: Submits a request to change the health status of a custom health check to healthy or unhealthy.

subcommands.name: update-private-dns-namespace
subcommands.description: Updates a private DNS namespace.

subcommands.name: update-public-dns-namespace
subcommands.description: Updates a public DNS namespace.

subcommands.name: update-service
subcommands.description: Submits a request to perform the following operations: Update the TTL setting for existing DnsRecords configurations Add, update, or delete HealthCheckConfig for a specified service You can't add, update, or delete a HealthCheckCustomConfig configuration.

subcommands.name: update-service-attributes
subcommands.description: Submits a request to update a specified service to add service-level attributes.
